1479-2841-8104-8293.easyPrerequisites:

Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.

Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.

When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3129-4231-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3129-4231-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.

Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.

Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Oreskos Sun Guide to become an artifact.

Repeat.

Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

6285-6590.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
6285-6590.description:
Cast Overture by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.
6285-6590.notes: If the opponent had an empty graveyard and an odd number of cards in their library when the combo is performed, they will have one card remaining in their library.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-5427-6488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-5427-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Tor Wauki the Younger.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Tor Wauki the Younger.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Tor Wauki the Younger.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-5427-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.
